info.name: WLMS Phase 2 API Tests
info.description: 26 solicitudes automatizadas con aserciones de estado, esquema JSON y contenido. Incluye un flujo de ventas encadenado: login -> usuario -> cliente -> stock -> crear orden de venta -> agregar línea (reserva stock) -> rechazos 422 por validación -> avanzar a Processing -> verificar -> cancelar -> verificar que el stock reservado se libera -> verificar Cancelled -> rechazar avance y segunda cancelación. Al final el inventario queda igual que al inicio.

pm.test('Sales order matches JSON schema', () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "object", "required": ["so_id", "customer_id", "created_by", "status", "payment_status"], "properties": {"so_id": {"type": "integer"}, "customer_id": {"type": "integer"}, "created_by": {"type": "integer"}, "status": {"type": "string"}, "payment_status": {"type": "string"}}}));

pm.test('SO is linked to the customer and current user', () => { pm.expect(body.customer_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('customerId'))); pm.expect(body.created_by).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId'))); });
pm.test('New SO starts Pending and Unpaid', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('Pending'); pm.expect(body.payment_status).to.eql('Unpaid'); });

pm.test('Error points to quantity', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail.map(d => d.loc.join('.')).join(' ')).to.include('quantity'));

item.name: 19 - Flow: reject line with missing fields

exec: pm.test('Validation error matches JSON schema', () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "object", "required": ["detail"], "properties": {"detail": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["loc", "msg", "type"], "properties": {"loc": {"type": "array"}, "msg": {"type": "string"}, "type": {"type": "string"}}}}}}));

pm.test('Error lists the missing fields', () => { const locs = pm.response.json().detail.map(d => d.loc.join('.')).join(' '); pm.expect(locs).to.include('quantity'); pm.expect(locs).to.include('unit_price'); });

item.name: 20 - Flow: advance sales order to Processing

exec: pm.test('Advance is confirmed for this SO', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('soId'))));

item.name: 21 - Flow: verify sales order detail and line

exec: pm.test('SO detail matches JSON schema', () => pm.response.to.have.jsonSchema({"type": "object", "required": ["so_id", "customer_name", "created_by", "status", "payment_status", "lines"], "properties": {"so_id": {"type": "integer"}, "customer_name": {"type": "string"}, "created_by": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}, "payment_status": {"type": "string"}, "lines": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["item_name", "ordered_quantity", "shipped_quantity", "pending_quantity", "unit_price", "line_total", "uom_symbol"], "properties": {"item_name": {"type": "string"}, "ordered_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "shipped_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "pending_quantity": {"type": "number"}, "unit_price": {"type": "number"}, "line_total": {"type": "number"}, "uom_symbol": {"type": "string"}}}}}}));

pm.test('Line is stored with the requested values', () => { pm.expect(body.lines).to.have.lengthOf(1); const l = body.lines[0]; pm.expect(l.item_name).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('stockItemName')); pm.expect(Number(l.ordered_quantity)).to.eql(1); pm.expect(Number(l.pending_quantity)).to.eql(1); pm.expect(Number(l.unit_price)).to.eql(12.5); pm.expect(Number(l.line_total)).to.eql(12.5); });

pm.test('Cancellation releases reservations', () => { const m = pm.response.json().message; pm.expect(m).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('soId'))); pm.expect(m).to.include('Reserved stock released'); });
